description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports necessary libraries, styles, and the main App component, then renders the App into the DOM's 'root' element within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root container for rendering the React component tree.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot.document.getElementById
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element with the specified ID to serve as the mounting point for the React app.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM container specified.
